name: tester
description: Tests your running app's API, UI and failure handling with checks drawn from a spec or your git diff. Returns a pass/fail table with evidence for each check.

run_retention.title: Runs kept per repository
run_retention.description: How many past runs to keep for each repository, counting all its worktrees together. The oldest finished runs are deleted beyond it.

explore.title: Exploratory suite
explore.description: Run an exploratory suite that looks for defects the spec does not describe. Its findings count only once a deterministic check reproduces them.
